 [[package]]

name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:
    branches: [main]

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.event.pull_request.number || github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  test:
    timeout-minutes: 20
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@07a047e608db84b3d8c06cd9a7c7dcc9c355c18e # v10.3.2

      - uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --locked --extra dev

      - name: Test CI policy scripts and plugin hooks
        run: |
          node -e "
            const major = Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0]);
            console.log('Node ' + process.versions.node);
            if (major < 20) {
              console.error('Node >= 20 required for node:test and --import');
              process.exit(1);
            }
          "
          node --test .github/scripts/*.test.cjs .claude/plugins/planchk-router/test/planchk-router.test.mjs

      - name: Compile
        run: uv run --no-sync python -m compileall -q triggarr

      - name: Run tests with branch coverage
        id: pytest
        run: |
          set +e
          start_seconds=$(date +%s)
          uv run --no-sync pytest tests/ -q --junitxml=test-results.xml --cov=triggarr --cov-branch --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml
          status=$?
          end_seconds=$(date +%s)
          set -e
          echo "test_exit=$status" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "test_seconds=$((end_seconds - start_seconds))" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          exit 0

      - name: Upload test evidence
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: test-results
          path: test-results.xml
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Write coverage provenance
        env:
          PR_HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.head.sha }}
          PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}
          TEST_EXIT: ${{ steps.pytest.outputs.test_exit }}
          TEST_SECONDS: ${{ steps.pytest.outputs.test_seconds }}
        run: |
          node .github/scripts/coverage-provenance.cjs write --coverage coverage.xml --test-exit "$TEST_EXIT" --test-seconds "$TEST_SECONDS" --out coverage-provenance.json

      - name: Upload coverage evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: coverage-${{ github.run_id }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            coverage.xml
            coverage-provenance.json
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 14

      - name: Fail if tests failed
        env:
          TEST_EXIT: ${{ steps.pytest.outputs.test_exit }}
        run: |
          if [ "$TEST_EXIT" != "0" ]; then
            echo "pytest failed (exit $TEST_EXIT); coverage collection did not change this result" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

  lint:
    timeout-minutes: 20
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@07a047e608db84b3d8c06cd9a7c7dcc9c355c18e # v10.3.2

      - uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --locked --extra dev

      - name: Run ruff
        run: uv run --no-sync ruff check triggarr/ tests/

  docker:
    needs: [test, lint]
    timeout-minutes: 20
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - name: Set up Docker Buildx
        uses: docker/setup-buildx-action@f87e5991a6d7451dcb8d9637bfbc97413f497069 # v4

      - name: Read package version for image provenance
        id: image-meta
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PYTHON'
          import os, re, tomllib
          with open('pyproject.toml', 'rb') as source:
              version = tomllib.load(source)['project']['version']
          if not re.fullmatch(r'[A-Za-z0-9.!+_-]+', version):
              raise SystemExit('Invalid image version label')
          with open(os.environ['GITHUB_OUTPUT'], 'a') as output:
              output.write(f'version={version}\n')
          PYTHON

      - name: Build Docker image
        uses: docker/build-push-action@c3c9e263c25d99ce0380d002d59b67737d91b0dc # v7
        with:
          context: .
          load: true
          tags: triggarr:ci-test
          labels: |
            org.opencontainers.image.source=https://github.com/${{ github.repository }}
            org.opencontainers.image.revision=${{ github.sha }}
            org.opencontainers.image.version=${{ steps.image-meta.outputs.version }}
          cache-from: type=gha
          cache-to: type=gha,mode=max

      - name: Audit actual image dependencies
        run: |
          docker run --rm --entrypoint python triggarr:ci-test -m pip freeze --all --exclude triggarr > image-requirements.txt
          test -s image-requirements.txt
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@07a047e608db84b3d8c06cd9a7c7dcc9c355c18e # v10.3.2
      - name: Check image dependencies match uv.lock
        run: |
          uv export --locked --no-dev --no-emit-project --no-hashes --format requirements-txt --output-file requirements-locked.txt
          docker run --rm -v "$PWD/.github/scripts:/check:ro" --entrypoint python triggarr:ci-test /check/image_lock_consistency.py --dump-environment > image-environment.json
          uv run --no-project --with packaging==26.0 python .github/scripts/image_lock_consistency.py --locked requirements-locked.txt --freeze image-requirements.txt --environment image-environment.json
      - name: Check image dependency vulnerabilities
        run: uvx --from pip-audit==2.10.1 pip-audit --strict --no-deps --disable-pip -r image-requirements.txt

      - name: Save the audited image
        run: |
          docker image inspect triggarr:ci-test --format '{{.Id}}' > image-id.txt
          docker save triggarr:ci-test -o image.tar
          sha256sum image.tar > image.tar.sha256
      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: audited-image
          path: |
            image.tar
            image.tar.sha256
            image-id.txt
            image-requirements.txt
          if-no-files-found: error
          retention-days: 30

      - name: Download the published CI artifact for round-trip verification
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: audited-image
          path: restored-image
      - name: Verify release image round trip
        working-directory: restored-image
        run: |
          sha256sum -c image.tar.sha256
          docker image rm triggarr:ci-test
          docker load -i image.tar
          test "$(docker image inspect triggarr:ci-test --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$(cat image-id.txt)"
          docker run --rm --entrypoint python triggarr:ci-test -m pip freeze --all --exclude triggarr > restored-requirements.txt
          diff -u image-requirements.txt restored-requirements.txt

  secrets:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
      - uses: gitleaks/gitleaks-action@e0c47f4f8be36e29cdc102c57e68cb5cbf0e8d1e # v3.0.0
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GITLEAKS_ENABLE_COMMENTS: 'false'
          GITLEAKS_ENABLE_UPLOAD_ARTIFACT: 'false'

  # Always runs and is required: a skip can never fake a CI ready pass (CIMAINT-04).
  actionlint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    env:
      ACTIONLINT_VERSION: "1.7.12"
      ACTIONLINT_SHA256: "8aca8db96f1b94770f1b0d72b6dddcb1ebb8123cb3712530b08cc387b349a3d8"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Require shellcheck for run-step linting
        run: |
          command -v shellcheck || { echo "shellcheck is not on PATH; actionlint would skip shell checks" >&2; exit 1; }
          shellcheck --version

      - name: Install actionlint (pinned binary, checksum-verified)
        run: |
          curl -fsSLO "https://github.com/rhysd/actionlint/releases/download/v${ACTIONLINT_VERSION}/actionlint_${ACTIONLINT_VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz"
          echo "$ACTIONLINT_SHA256  actionlint_${ACTIONLINT_VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz" | sha256sum -c -
          tar -xzf "actionlint_${ACTIONLINT_VERSION}_linux_amd64.tar.gz" actionlint

      - name: Lint all workflows
        run: ./actionlint -color

  dependencies:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@07a047e608db84b3d8c06cd9a7c7dcc9c355c18e # v10.3.2
      - uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version: '3.13'
      - name: Export locked production dependencies
        run: uv export --locked --no-dev --no-emit-project --no-hashes --format requirements-txt --output-file requirements-audit.txt
      - name: Audit dependencies (scanner errors also fail)
        run: uvx --from pip-audit==2.10.1 pip-audit --strict --no-deps --disable-pip -r requirements-audit.txt

  image-smoke:
    needs: [docker]
    timeout-minutes: 15
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@07a047e608db84b3d8c06cd9a7c7dcc9c355c18e # v10.3.2

      - uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --locked --extra dev

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: audited-image
          path: image

      - name: Verify and load audited image
        working-directory: image
        run: |
          sha256sum -c image.tar.sha256
          docker load -i image.tar
          test "$(docker image inspect triggarr:ci-test --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$(cat image-id.txt)"

      - name: Run shipped-image smoke test
        run: uv run --no-sync python -m tests.harness.image_smoke run --image triggarr:ci-test --expected-image-id-file image/image-id.txt

      - name: Rehearse release identity against audited image
        run: |
          test "$(docker image inspect triggarr:ci-test --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$(cat image/image-id.txt)"
          IMAGE_ID="$(cat image/image-id.txt)"
          export IMAGE_ID
          IMAGE_VERSION="$(docker image inspect triggarr:ci-test --format '{{ index .Config.Labels "org.opencontainers.image.version" }}')"
          export IMAGE_VERSION
          REHEARSAL_SHA="$(git rev-parse HEAD)"
          export REHEARSAL_SHA
          node .github/scripts/release-identity-rehearsal.cjs

  browser-e2e:
    needs: [docker]
    timeout-minutes: 20
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: astral-sh/setup-uv@07a047e608db84b3d8c06cd9a7c7dcc9c355c18e # v10.3.2

      - uses: actions/setup-python@6d4fd22b20465ccc0f7354476588e8df7c9ca0e0 # v7.1.0
        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: uv sync --locked --extra dev

      - name: Install Chromium for Playwright
        run: uv run --no-sync playwright install --with-deps chromium

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: audited-image
          path: image

      - name: Verify and load audited image
        working-directory: image
        run: |
          sha256sum -c image.tar.sha256
          docker load -i image.tar
          test "$(docker image inspect triggarr:ci-test --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$(cat image-id.txt)"

      - name: Run browser regression suite
        env:
          TRIGGARR_E2E_IMAGE: triggarr:ci-test
        run: |
          EXPECTED_IMAGE_ID="$(cat image/image-id.txt)"
          export EXPECTED_IMAGE_ID
          set +e
          uv run --no-sync pytest tests/e2e -q -p no:cacheprovider -m credential_pages --browser chromium --tracing off --screenshot off --video off --output e2e-artifacts/credential --junitxml e2e-credential.xml
          credential_status=$?
          uv run --no-sync pytest tests/e2e -q -p no:cacheprovider -m "not credential_pages" --browser chromium --tracing retain-on-failure --screenshot only-on-failure --output e2e-artifacts/pages --junitxml e2e-pages.xml
          pages_status=$?
          set -e
          if [ "$credential_status" -ne 0 ] || [ "$pages_status" -ne 0 ]; then
            echo "Browser regression suite failed: credential_pages exit=$credential_status, pages exit=$pages_status" >&2
            exit 1
          fi

      - name: Require a complete browser-suite result
        run: |
          python3 - <<'PY'
          import sys
          import xml.etree.ElementTree as ET

          def load(path):
              root = ET.parse(path).getroot()
              suite = root.find("testsuite") if root.tag == "testsuites" else root
              return {
                  "tests": int(suite.get("tests", 0)),
                  "skipped": int(suite.get("skipped", 0)),
                  "failures": int(suite.get("failures", 0)),
                  "errors": int(suite.get("errors", 0)),
              }

          checks = [("e2e-credential.xml", 6), ("e2e-pages.xml", 1)]
          bad = []
          for path, minimum in checks:
              try:
                  result = load(path)
              except Exception as exc:
                  bad.append(f"{path}: could not be parsed ({exc})")
                  continue
              if result["tests"] < minimum:
                  bad.append(f"{path}: expected at least {minimum} tests, saw {result['tests']}")
              if result["skipped"] != 0:
                  bad.append(f"{path}: expected 0 skipped, saw {result['skipped']}")
              if result["failures"] != 0:
                  bad.append(f"{path}: expected 0 failures, saw {result['failures']}")
              if result["errors"] != 0:
                  bad.append(f"{path}: expected 0 errors, saw {result['errors']}")
          if bad:
              sys.exit("Browser suite result incomplete: " + "; ".join(bad))
          print("Browser suite result complete: credential and pages junit files both report success with no skips")
          PY

      - name: Upload browser failure evidence
        if: >-
          failure() &&
          hashFiles('e2e-artifacts/credential/scan-complete.json') != '' &&
          hashFiles('e2e-artifacts/pages/scan-complete.json') != ''
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2
        with:
          name: browser-e2e-failure
          path: e2e-artifacts
          retention-days: 14
          if-no-files-found: warn

  # Policy: docs/os-scan-policy.md. Never replace with aquasecurity/trivy-action or
  # setup-trivy (compromised March 2026, CVE-2026-33634).
  os-scan:
    needs: [docker]
    timeout-minutes: 15
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    env:
      TRIVY_VERSION: "0.76.1"
      TRIVY_SHA256: "c7cbe3137fb8a48a17574bede3dd6beb16742d1e9772929940fc90082c39d9c0"
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: audited-image
          path: image

      - name: Verify audited image checksum
        working-directory: image
        run: sha256sum -c image.tar.sha256

      - name: Install Trivy (pinned binary, checksum-verified)
        run: |
          curl -fsSLO "https://github.com/aquasecurity/trivy/releases/download/v${TRIVY_VERSION}/trivy_${TRIVY_VERSION}_Linux-64bit.tar.gz"

  contents: read

jobs:
  preflight:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    # Skip untrusted or unsuccessful triggers so failed/cancelled CI does not
    # produce failed Release runs; release-policy.cjs still re-verifies independently.
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
       github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
       github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
       github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == 'main' &&
       github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository)

      contents: read
      actions: read
    outputs:
      sha: ${{ steps.policy.outputs.sha }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: .github/scripts
      - uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        id: policy
        with:
          script: |
            const {preflight} = require('./.github/scripts/release-policy.cjs');
            await preflight({github, context, core});

  release:
    concurrency:
      group: publish-${{ github.event_name == 'push' && github.ref || 'main' }}
      cancel-in-progress: false
    needs: preflight
    timeout-minutes: 30
    # Run on release tags directly, or after same-repo push CI succeeds on main.
    if: >-
      (github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')) ||
      (github.event_name == 'workflow_run' &&
       github.event.workflow_run.conclusion == 'success' &&
       github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
       github.event.workflow_run.head_branch == 'main' &&
       github.event.workflow_run.head_repository.full_name == github.repository)
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    permissions:
      packages: write
      contents: read
      actions: read

    steps:
      # A valid run can become stale while waiting for the publishing queue.
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: main
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: .github/scripts
      - uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        id: recheck
        with:
          script: |
            const {preflight} = require('./.github/scripts/release-policy.cjs');
            await preflight({github, context, core});
      - name: Validate release tag format
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        with:
          script: |
            const {parseReleaseTag} = require('./.github/scripts/release-policy.cjs');
            const version = parseReleaseTag(context.ref);
            core.info(`Release tag format accepted: ${version}`);
      - name: Download exact successful CI image
        uses: actions/download-artifact@9000827ccba6bdab643e8b6fd33ac0654aef8333 # v8.0.2
        with:
          name: audited-image
          path: image
          run-id: ${{ steps.recheck.outputs.run_id }}
          github-token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
      - name: Verify and load audited image
        working-directory: image
        run: |
          sha256sum -c image.tar.sha256
          docker load -i image.tar
          test "$(docker image inspect triggarr:ci-test --format '{{.Id}}')" = "$(cat image-id.txt)"
      - name: Read audited image version label
        if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
        id: image-version
        run: |
          version="$(docker image inspect triggarr:ci-test --format '{{ index .Config.Labels "org.opencontainers.image.version" }}')"
          if ! [[ "$version" =~ ^[A-Za-z0-9.+_-]*$ ]]; then

          script: |
            const {releaseIdentityGate} = require('./.github/scripts/release-policy.cjs');
            await releaseIdentityGate({github, context, core, sha: process.env.RELEASE_SHA, imageVersion: process.env.IMAGE_VERSION});

      - uses: docker/login-action@81c6f93d4bc991e510b342a00b419b3bb4efc5c6 # v4
        with:
          registry: ghcr.io
          username: ${{ github.actor }}
          password: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Detect Docker Hub mirror
        id: dockerhub
        env:
          DOCKERHUB_USERNAME: ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          DOCKERHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}
        run: |
          if [ -n "$DOCKERHUB_USERNAME" ] && [ -n "$DOCKERHUB_TOKEN" ]; then
            echo "enabled=true" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "image=${DOCKERHUB_USERNAME}/triggarr" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          else
            echo "enabled=false" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
            echo "image=" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          fi

      - name: Login to Docker Hub
        if: steps.dockerhub.outputs.enabled == 'true'
        uses: docker/login-action@81c6f93d4bc991e510b342a00b419b3bb4efc5c6 # v4
        with:
          username: ${{ vars.DOCKERHUB_USERNAME }}
          password: ${{ secrets.DOCKERHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Extract metadata
        id: meta
        uses: docker/metadata-action@dc802804100637a589fabce1cb79ff13a1411302 # v6
        with:
          images: |
            ghcr.io/thejuran/triggarr
            ${{ steps.dockerhub.outputs.image }}
          tags: |
            type=raw,value=main,enable=${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' }}
            type=raw,value=dev,enable=${{ github.event_name == 'workflow_run' }}
            type=raw,value=latest,enable=${{ startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v') }}
            type=ref,event=tag

      - name: Publish audited image without rebuilding
        env:
          IMAGE_TAGS: ${{ steps.meta.outputs.tags }}
        run: |
          while IFS= read -r target; do
            [ -n "$target" ] || continue
            docker tag triggarr:ci-test "$target"
            docker push "$target"
          done <<< "$IMAGE_TAGS"

  # Only this tag-only job holds contents: write (CIMAINT-07). Python
  # distributions are no longer attached to releases (D-14); earlier
  # releases keep theirs.
  github-release:
    needs: [preflight, release]
    if: github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    concurrency:
      group: github-release-${{ github.ref }}
      cancel-in-progress: false

    permissions:
      contents: write

    steps:
      - name: Create GitHub Release
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}
          TAG_NAME: ${{ github.ref_name }}
        run: |
          if gh release view "$TAG_NAME" &>/dev/null; then
            echo "Release $TAG_NAME already exists"
          else
            gh release create "$TAG_NAME" \
              --title "Triggarr $TAG_NAME" \
              --generate-notes \
              --latest
          fi

    name: Review acceptance
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    environment: review-acceptance
    steps:
      # The protected environment requires owner approval. Never execute PR code.
      # Gate code is pinned to the reviewed policy commit. Updating this pin
      # is a safeguard change requiring independent inspection before approval.
      # Pinned in Phase 85 to the schema-2 keyed gate (registers keyed by PR and
      # head). This PR's own acceptance run uses this pin, so the gate change is
      # disclosed and independently inspected.
      - uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          ref: 8df9eaf9d68ad0e5fce469ef8393d05bb4ba3fc3
          persist-credentials: false
          sparse-checkout: .github/scripts
      - uses: actions/github-script@3a2844b7e9c422d3c10d287c895573f7108da1b3 # v9.0.0
        env:
          DISPOSITIONS: ${{ vars.REVIEW_DISPOSITIONS }}

          script: |
            const {assess} = require('./.github/scripts/review-acceptance.cjs');
            const {owner,repo} = context.repo;
            const eventPR = context.payload.pull_request;
            const {data: pr} = await github.rest.pulls.get({owner,repo,pull_number:eventPR.number});
            if (pr.base.ref !== 'main' || pr.state !== 'open') throw Error('Not an open PR to main');
            const head = eventPR.head.sha;
            const checks = await github.paginate(github.rest.checks.listForRef,{owner,repo,ref:head,filter:'all',per_page:100});

        with:
          python-version: "3.13"

        run: uv sync --locked --extra dev

      - name: Test CI policy scripts and plugin hooks
        run: |
          node -e "
            const major = Number(process.versions.node.split('.')[0]);
            console.log('Node ' + process.versions.node);
            if (major < 20) {
              console.error('Node >= 20 required for node:test and --import');
              process.exit(1);
            }

          node --test .github/scripts/*.test.cjs .claude/plugins/planchk-router/test/planchk-router.test.mjs

          uv run --no-sync pytest tests/ -q --junitxml=test-results.xml --cov=triggarr --cov-branch --cov-report=xml:coverage.xml
          status=$?
          end_seconds=$(date +%s)
          set -e
          echo "test_exit=$status" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"
          echo "test_seconds=$((end_seconds - start_seconds))" >> "$GITHUB_OUTPUT"

        if: always()

          PR_BASE_SHA: ${{ github.event.pull_request.base.sha }}

      - name: Upload coverage evidence
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@cf430e030ddbb5b0abf93d22962f4752f3646cd9 # v7.0.2

      - name: Fail if tests failed
        env:

"""Regression tests for GitHub workflow contracts."""

REPO_ROOT = Path(__file__).parent.parent
RELEASE_WORKFLOW = (REPO_ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "release.yml").read_text()
CI_WORKFLOW = (REPO_ROOT / ".github" / "workflows" / "ci.yml").read_text()
RELEASE_POLICY_TEXT = (REPO_ROOT / ".github" / "scripts" / "release-policy.cjs").read_text()

TAG_ONLY_IF = "github.event_name == 'push' && startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/tags/v')"

GATE_STEP_NAMES = (
    "Validate release tag format",
    "Read audited image version label",
    "Verify release version identity",
)

# Steps that perform or trigger publication: pushing to a registry, creating/
# uploading a GitHub Release, or any equivalent promotion action/command.

    "docker/login-action",
    "docker/build-push-action",
    "softprops/action-gh-release",
    "ncipollo/release-action",
)

    "twine upload",

)
# A bare status-check function call anywhere in an `if:` bypasses the normal

STATUS_BYPASS_SUBSTRINGS = ("always(", "cancelled(", "failure(")

def _is_publication_step(step: dict) -> bool:
    uses = str(step.get("uses") or "")
    if any(uses.startswith(prefix) for prefix in PUBLICATION_USES_PREFIXES):
        return True
    run = str(step.get("run") or "")
    return any(substring in run for substring in PUBLICATION_RUN_SUBSTRINGS)


def _has_status_bypass(if_expr: object) -> bool:
    if not if_expr:
        return False
    normalized = _normalize_expression(str(if_expr))
    return any(substring in normalized for substring in STATUS_BYPASS_SUBSTRINGS)


def _job_needs_release(jobs: dict, job_name: str, visited: set[str] | None = None) -> bool:
    if visited is None:
        visited = set()
    if job_name in visited:
        return False
    visited.add(job_name)
    needs = jobs.get(job_name, {}).get("needs")
    if not needs:
        return False
    needs_list = [needs] if isinstance(needs, str) else list(needs)
    if "release" in needs_list:
        return True
    return any(_job_needs_release(jobs, dep, visited) for dep in needs_list)


def publication_bypass_violations(workflow: dict) -> list[str]:

    A rejection must block every publication path (registry login, image push,
    GitHub Release creation) -- not merely appear earlier in the file (D-31b).
    """
    violations: list[str] = []
    jobs = workflow.get("jobs", {})
    release_job = jobs.get("release", {})
    release_steps = release_job.get("steps", [])

    step_index_by_name = {step.get("name"): idx for idx, step in enumerate(release_steps) if "name" in step}
    gate_index = step_index_by_name.get("Verify release version identity")

    for idx, step in enumerate(release_steps):
        label = step.get("name") or step.get("uses") or step.get("run") or f"step {idx}"
        if _is_publication_step(step):
            if gate_index is None or idx < gate_index:
                violations.append(f"release.{label}: publication step runs before the version identity gate")
            if _has_status_bypass(step.get("if")):
                violations.append(f"release.{label}: publication step if-condition has a status-function bypass")
        if step.get("continue-on-error"):
            violations.append(f"release.{label}: continue-on-error set on a release-job step")

    if release_job.get("continue-on-error"):
        violations.append("release: continue-on-error set on the release job")

    for gate_name in GATE_STEP_NAMES:
        idx = step_index_by_name.get(gate_name)
        if idx is None:
            violations.append(f"release.{gate_name}: gate step is missing")
            continue
        gate_if = _normalize_expression(str(release_steps[idx].get("if", "")))
        if gate_if != _normalize_expression(TAG_ONLY_IF):
            violations.append(f"release.{gate_name}: gate step if-condition is not tag-only")

    for job_name, job in jobs.items():
        if job_name == "github-release":
            continue
        permissions = job.get("permissions") or {}
        if permissions.get("contents") == "write":
            violations.append(f"{job_name}: holds contents: write (only github-release may)")

    github_release_job = jobs.get("github-release")
    github_release_steps = (github_release_job or {}).get("steps", [])
    create_release_step = next((s for s in github_release_steps if s.get("name") == "Create GitHub Release"), None)

        violations.append("github-release: Create GitHub Release step missing")
    else:
        job_if = _normalize_expression(str(github_release_job.get("if", "")))
        if job_if != _normalize_expression(TAG_ONLY_IF):
            violations.append("github-release: job if-condition is not tag-only")
        needs = github_release_job.get("needs") or []
        needs_list = [needs] if isinstance(needs, str) else list(needs)
        if "preflight" not in needs_list or "release" not in needs_list:
            violations.append("github-release: needs must include preflight and release")
        if _has_status_bypass(create_release_step.get("if")):
            violations.append(
